scope: Pre-refinement quality assessment for bug reports. This is not a Definition of Done.

scoring.note: Criteria with implemented=false carry no points and do not affect score or ready gate.

assessmentRules.readyGate: A bug cannot be 'Ready' if any required criterion is 'flag' or 'not-assessable'.

criteria.passCondition: At least two numbered steps are present and describe a reproducible scenario.

criteria.description: Clearly separates expected behavior from actual behavior.
criteria.passCondition: Both expected and actual behavior are explicitly stated.

criteria.description: Includes environment information (device, OS, browser, app version).
criteria.passCondition: At least device/OS or browser/version is provided.

criteria.description: Contains acceptance criteria or verification steps for the fix.
criteria.passCondition: At least one testable outcome for verifying the fix is present.

criteria.description: Acceptance criteria or verification steps are observable and testable.
criteria.passCondition: Each criterion has a verifiable outcome; vague terms are defined or flagged.

criteria.description: Flags signs that the bug fix is likely too broad or complex for a single sprint.
criteria.passCondition: No broadness indicators are present, or any conclusion explicitly remains a risk signal.
indicators: Root cause spans multiple systems or services
Multiple independent bugs combined in one issue

criteria.description: States or infers severity (Critical, Major, Minor) with justification.
criteria.passCondition: Severity is stated or inferred from impact; the model must not invent severity without evidence.

criteria.description: States how often the bug occurs (always, sometimes, rarely) and under what conditions.
criteria.passCondition: Reproducibility is stated or explicitly flagged as unknown.

criteria.description: Describes the impact on users, revenue, or compliance.
criteria.passCondition: Impact is described or explicitly flagged as unknown.

examples.title: PDF download fails on mobile Safari
examples.summary: Clear reproduction steps, expected vs. actual behavior, environment info, and testable verification criteria.

examples.title: Intermittent login failures across all platforms
examples.body: Users sometimes cannot log in on web, iOS, and Android.
examples.expectedObservation: Root cause may span authentication service, session management, and multiple clients; recommend investigation spike before fix.
